title: Software Engineering Intern 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related quantitative field.
qualification: Pursuing degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related technical discipline.
description: Work on core software products, scale enterprise systems, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: International students applying to postgraduate degree programs at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic excellence.
description: Full-cost scholarships awarded to outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with experience in JavaScript, Vue.js/React, and modern web development.
qualification: Proficiency in HTML/CSS, JavaScript frameworks, Git, and responsive web design.
description: Build scalable and intuitive UI components for the GitLab open-source DevOps platform fully remotely.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school or higher education institutions globally.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD + Azure Credits & Mentorship
qualification: Enrolled student with a passion for tech innovation and artificial intelligence.
description: Global technology competition encouraging student teams to create impactful solutions addressing global challenges using AI.

title: Associate Data Scientist
eligibility: Early-career professionals with 0-2 years of experience in machine learning and data analytics.
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or Math.
description: Analyze multi-dimensional enterprise datasets, build predictive models, and deploy machine learning pipelines.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide; no prior programming experience required.
description: An entry-level course introducing fundamental concepts of computer science, algorithms, data structures, Python, SQL, and web application development.
